subject.title: fix(mcp): allow token auth profiles for bearer projection

question: Should MCP bearer projection permanently reuse `oauth.authProfileId` for static token profiles, or should OpenClaw expose a bearer-neutral profile-reference contract and migrate the OAuth-specific shape?
rationale: Both paths can be implemented safely, but they establish different durable user configuration and upgrade contracts that code review cannot choose on behalf of maintainers.

options.title: Adopt a bearer-neutral contract
options.body: Define a non-OAuth-specific MCP auth-profile reference, document and test the migration from the current OAuth shape, then retain this projection behavior behind that canonical contract.

options.title: Approve the expanded OAuth field
options.body: Accept `oauth.authProfileId` as the permanent bearer-profile selector and document that both OAuth and static token lifecycles are supported there.

options.title: Defer the capability
options.body: Keep current OAuth-only bearer projection until an MCP authentication configuration direction is chosen.

recommendation.title: Adopt a bearer-neutral contract
recommendation.body: Define a non-OAuth-specific MCP auth-profile reference, document and test the migration from the current OAuth shape, then retain this projection behavior behind that canonical contract.
